_comment: SalesKick ICP scoring model for high-ticket coaching / biz-op / agency businesses. Applied deterministically by scripts/score.py. Offer = free show-rate course. Edit here, not in code.

gates._comment: Hard filters. Title must match an ICP role and not be excluded. Size/industry only reject when the data is present (unknown values pass, since personal-brand profiles are often sparse).

fit_dimensions._comment: Each dimension declares which lead field(s) to read via match_field (string or list) or range_field. Max raw fit score = 15.

triggers._comment: High-intent bonus signals tied to the show-rate offer. Agent sets each signal_* boolean from observable research. Max bonus = 15.

items.description: The post they engaged with (or their own posts) is about show rate, no-shows, or booked calls not showing up.
Lead explicitly complains about no-shows, cancellations, ghosted calls, or low show rate.
Lead or their company is actively hiring closers, appointment setters, or commission sales reps.
Evidence they run paid ads to a booking calendar / call funnel (booked calls from paid traffic).
Post they engaged with is about closing, setters, call conversion, or sales-call mechanics.
Clear high-ticket offer (mastermind, $3k+ program, done-for-you retainer) sold via sales calls.
Lead mentions building or scaling a sales team of closers/setters.
Large following / high inbound volume implying many booked calls where show rate compounds.
Recently launched a new program, offer, or cohort (fresh push of booked calls).

confidence_levels.high: Signal verified from structured public data (LinkedIn profile, company page, course/sales page).
confidence_levels.medium: Signal inferred from post text, headline, or unstructured mentions.
confidence_levels.low: Limited data — signal assumed absent or unknown.

scoring.confidence_cap_rule: If 2 or more fit dimensions are marked low confidence, cap tier at B and flag for review.

A.description: High-fit + high-intent. Immediate personalized show-rate outreach.
A.personalization: required — must reference influencer + matched angle hook

B.description: Good fit, moderate intent. Semi-personalized sequence.
B.personalization: preferred — reference influencer niche at minimum
